title: Start with your ZIP code
description: Check whether FEMA Individual Assistance may be open where you live.
zipError: Enter a 5-digit ZIP code. Use numbers only.
error: We could not check right now. Check your connection and try again.
pickCounty: Your ZIP code covers more than one county. Which county do you live in?
iaOpen: Individual Assistance is open in {county}. You may qualify. FEMA decides.
iaClosed: Individual Assistance is not open in {county} for this disaster.
registrationClosed: Registration closed on {date}. If you missed it, call the FEMA Helpline at 1-800-621-3362 and ask what you can do.
snBody: You may qualify for up to ${amount} to help with urgent needs. FEMA decides.
snApplyBy: Apply by {date}. This date may be extended.
snNotTotal: This is not the total help available. Other help may be offered.
noneBody: That means we did not find a FEMA disaster declaration that covers your county right now. It does not mean you cannot get help. Local groups and other programs may still help.
noneCall211: Call 211 to find local help, food, and shelter.
noneFema: Call the FEMA Helpline at 1-800-621-3362 to ask about your area.
